description: This file implements security-related functionalities for a FastAPI application, including password hashing, password verification, JWT token creation and decoding, and generating Supabase Realtime JWT tokens. It uses external libraries such as fastapi, jose, passlib, and imports configuration settings.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a password using the pbkdf2_sha256 scheme via passlib.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a hashed password.

methods.name: str create_access_token(subject: str, extra_claims: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT access token for API authentication, including optional additional claims and expiration time.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, raising an HTTP 401 error if invalid.

methods.name: str create_supabase_realtime_jwt(subject: str, role: str = "authenticated", channels: Optional[list[str]] = None, expires_minutes: int = 60)
methods.description: Generates a Supabase Realtime-compatible JWT token with specified subject, role, channels, and expiration, using a secret key from settings.
